question: When my Clone resolves, I'll have it copy Player 2's Serra Angel, which has Frogify on it. Is my Clone a Frog, and does it have flying?

expected.shortAnswer: Not a Frog, and yes, it has flying: Clone copies only what's printed.
expected.answer: Your Clone isn't a Frog, and it has flying and vigilance: it enters as a Serra Angel. Copying takes only the copiable values — the printed card, as modified by other copy effects (707.2) — applied in layer 1 (613.1a). Frogify is an Aura's effect on Player 2's Serra Angel, not a copy effect, so it doesn't carry over to your Clone.

whyHard: A copy takes only copiable values (layer 1), so an effect that changed the original afterwards, such as an Aura, is not copied.
